entries.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
entries.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能类别）- 100 金币。

entries.source:
My husband, Rashim, is a Sun Paladin. He was sent to clear the spider lair of Ardhungol to the north of this town.
It has been three days now. He should be back by now. I have a feeling something terrible has happened to him. Please find him!
He should have a magical stone given by the Anorithil to create a portal back here, yet he did not use it!
entries.target:
我的丈夫拉希姆是一名太阳骑士。他被派去清理本镇北方的阿尔德胡格蜘蛛巢穴。
如今已经过去三天了。按理说他现在早该回来了。我有一种不祥的预感，他可能遭遇了可怕的不测。求求你帮我找到他！
他身上本该携带着星月术士所赠的魔法石，用来开启返回此地的传送门，可他却一直没有使用！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall, hooded man stares at you*#WHITE#
Yes...yes...you look like a promising warrior indeed...
I have an offer, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You see...I am an agent for the Arena. I look for promising warriors that
can provide a good show for our audience. Perhaps you are strong enough to join.
All you need to do is beat three of my men in battle, and you shall be rewarded.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You consider the offer of the mysterious hooded man for a moment*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大、头戴兜帽的男人注视着你*#WHITE#
是的……是的……你的确像是一名很有潜力的战士……
我有个提议，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你看……我是竞技场的招募员，专门寻找有潜力的战士，
为观众献上精彩表演。或许你足够强大，能够加入我们。
你只需在战斗中击败我的三名手下，就能获得奖励。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你思量了片刻这个神秘兜帽人的提议*

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man lets out a disappointed sigh*#WHITE#
That's unfortunate. We could have used someone like you.
You are just the type the audience likes. You could have been a champion.
Alas, if you stand by your choice, we shall never meet again.
However, if you change your mind...I will #YELLOW#stay in Derth just a little
longer.#WHITE#
If I am still around, we can have a deal. Think about it, @playerdescriptor.race@.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*男人失望地叹了口气*#WHITE#
真遗憾。我们本可以用上你这样的人。
你正是观众喜欢的类型，本可以成为一名冠军。
唉，如果你坚持这个选择，我们就再也不会见面了。
不过，如果你改变主意……我还会#YELLOW#在德斯镇多待
一小段时间。#WHITE#
只要我还在，我们就仍可谈成这笔交易。好好想想吧，@playerdescriptor.race@。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Cornac rogue comes back from the shadows*#WHITE#
Well done, @playerdescriptor.race@! I knew you had potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The rogue takes off his hood, showing a fairly young, but unmistakably
#LIGHT_GREEN#battle-hardened man.#WHITE#
The name's Rej. I work for the arena to recruit great fighters who can give a
good show... and not die in two blows. You are one of those, indeed!
I won't keep you away from your adventures. I was there too, long ago.
But we can make you a true champion, beloved by many and bathing in diamonds.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you travel back to Derth in company of the rogue, you discuss your
#LIGHT_GREEN#battles in the forest. He provides you with great insight on your combat technique (#WHITE#+2 generic talent points#LIGHT_GREEN#)*
#WHITE#Very well, @playername@. I must go now.
Good luck in your adventures, and come visit us when you are done!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那名科纳克盗贼从阴影中现身*#WHITE#
干得漂亮，@playerdescriptor.race@！我就知道你有潜力。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*盗贼摘下兜帽，露出一张颇为年轻、
#LIGHT_GREEN#却显然久经战阵的男人面孔。#WHITE#
我叫瑞吉。我为竞技场招募优秀斗士，
他们既要能奉上精彩表演……也不能挨两下就死。你的确就是这种人！
我不会耽误你继续冒险。很久以前，我也曾踏上冒险之路。
但我们能把你培养成真正的冠军，让你受万众爱戴、坐拥无数钻石。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*你与盗贼结伴返回德斯镇，途中谈起自己在森林里的战斗。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他对你的战斗技巧提出了精辟见解（#WHITE#+2 通用技能点#LIGHT_GREEN#）*
#WHITE#好了，@playername@。我现在该走了。
祝你冒险顺利，等冒险结束后记得来找我们！

entries.source: Yes, tell me more.
entries.target: 是的，说说细节吧。

entries.source: No, see you.
entries.target: 不，再见。

entries.source: Welcome back, @playerdescriptor.race@. Are you ready to go?
entries.target: 欢迎回来，@playerdescriptor.race@。你准备好出发了吗？

entries.source: Let's go, Cornac.
entries.target: 走吧，科纳克人。

entries.source: Just a minute. I have to prepare my equipment.
entries.target: 再等一下。我得准备好装备。

entries.source: Gladiator's wares
entries.target: 角斗士商店

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A gigantic bone giant walks through the main gate.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Its shape is intricate and sharp, resembling a drake, but with countless
#LIGHT_GREEN#spikes instead of wings.
#LIGHT_GREEN#The massive undead stares at you with unusual...intellect.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You have heard of him. Ryal the Towering, your first obstacle!
#LIGHT_GREEN#As an eerie blue glow fills where its eyes should be, the undead giant
#LIGHT_GREEN#roars and multiple bones fly in your general direction!*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个庞大的骸骨巨人穿过正门。
#LIGHT_GREEN#它的身形繁复而尖锐，形似一头龙，
#LIGHT_GREEN#却以无数骨刺代替了双翼。
#LIGHT_GREEN#这具巨大的不死生物注视着你，目光中透出异乎寻常的……智慧。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你听说过它：高大的瑞尔，你的第一道难关！
#LIGHT_GREEN#它本应长着眼睛的地方泛起诡异蓝光；不死巨人
#LIGHT_GREEN#咆哮一声，无数骸骨朝你所在的大致方向飞射而来！*

entries.source: Have at you!!
entries.target: 放马过来！！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After taking several hits, the undead giant finally succumbs
#LIGHT_GREEN#to your attacks*
#LIGHT_GREEN#Suddenly, Ryal's body starts to regenerate!
#LIGHT_GREEN#Standing tall again, you can almost feel its emotionless skull staring
#LIGHT_GREEN#at you with...satisfaction.
#WHITE#Hehehe...well done, @playerdescriptor.race@.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Ryal quietly turns towards the gate and leaves, seemingly unharmed*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*挨了数次攻击后，不死巨人终于
#LIGHT_GREEN#倒在你的攻势下*
#LIGHT_GREEN#突然，瑞尔的身体开始再生！
#LIGHT_GREEN#它再次昂然挺立；你几乎能感觉到，那颗毫无表情的头骨
#LIGHT_GREEN#正……满意地注视着你。
#WHITE#呵呵呵……干得好，@playerdescriptor.race@。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*瑞尔默默转向大门离去，看起来毫发无损*

entries.source: It was fun, bone giant!
entries.target: 打得痛快，骸骨巨人！

entries.source: ...what? unharmed?
entries.target: ……什么？毫发无损？

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The wind chills as a young girl walks calmly through the gate.
#LIGHT_GREEN#She looks surprisingly young, with extremely pale skin and contrasting
#LIGHT_GREEN#long black hair. She examines you with eerie calmness*#WHITE#
I am known as Fryjia the Hailstorm. That's all you need to know, @playerdescriptor.race@. Let us begin.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The whole arena starts to get colder as she speaks, and the audience
#LIGHT_GREEN#starts wearing their finest winter cloaks*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一名少女从容地穿过大门，寒风随之袭来。
#LIGHT_GREEN#她年轻得出人意料，肌肤异常苍白，与一头黑色长发形成鲜明对比。
#LIGHT_GREEN#她以诡异的平静审视着你*#WHITE#
人们称我为冰雹弗里嘉。你只需知道这些，@playerdescriptor.race@。开始吧。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*随着她开口，整个竞技场越来越冷，观众
#LIGHT_GREEN#纷纷披上自己最好的冬用斗篷*

entries.source: Bring it!
entries.target: 来吧！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*With your final blow, Fryjia falls, unable to continue*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She awkwardly stands up, but doesn't seem critically injured*
#WHITE# I...I admit defeat.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The audience "oooohs" in awe. Fryjia has turned her back to you*
#WHITE# @playerdescriptor.race@. You are not the person I am looking for...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Leaving you wondering what she was talking about, the young girl walks
#LIGHT_GREEN#towards the gate. As it closes, you realize her eyes are wet with tears.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你的最后一击落下，弗里嘉倒地，再也无力继续战斗*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她有些狼狈地站起身来，但似乎并未受致命伤*
#WHITE# 我……我认输。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*观众惊叹着发出“噢——”声。弗里嘉背过身去*
#WHITE# @playerdescriptor.race@。你不是我要找的人……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*少女走向大门，留下你独自揣摩她话里的意思。
#LIGHT_GREEN#大门关上时，你才发现她眼中含着泪水。

entries.source: w...what was that about?
entries.target: 这……这是怎么回事？

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The gate opens, revealing a mature human woman in crimson robes.
#LIGHT_GREEN#She looks at you with a wide smile*
#WHITE# My, my, what a fine @playerdescriptor.race@ you are. What was your name again, @playername@? I am soo delighted to be your rival today.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She speaks quietly as if telling a secret* #WHITE#You know, so few get past the little one as of late, it's such a bore.#LIGHT_GREEN#*She giggles*#WHITE#
So! I am Riala, the Crimson. I came directly from Angolwen. Despite, you know, the whole thing with the Spellblaze, people still enjoy a few magic tricks!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She snaps her fingers, and then flames start dancing around her!*#WHITE#
Fryjia told me about you, the poor thing, so I will not underestimate such a promising aspirant #LIGHT_GREEN#*She smiles warmly* #WHITE#So, let's make haste my dear!
There is a battle to fight here!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*大门开启，一名身着深红长袍的成年女子出现在门后。
#LIGHT_GREEN#她灿烂地微笑着看向你*
#WHITE# 哎呀，哎呀，多出色的一位 @playerdescriptor.race@ 啊。你叫什么来着，@playername@？今天能成为你的对手，我可真是太高兴了。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她压低声音，仿佛在说一个秘密* #WHITE#你知道吗，最近能闯过那个小家伙的人实在太少了，真是无聊透顶。#LIGHT_GREEN#*她咯咯轻笑*#WHITE#
那么！我就是绯红里娅拉，刚从安格利文赶来。虽说嘛，魔法大爆炸闹出了那些事，但人们还是喜欢看点魔法把戏！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她打了个响指，火焰随即在她周围起舞！*#WHITE#
弗里嘉已经跟我说过你了，可怜的孩子。所以，我绝不会低估你这样前途无量的挑战者。#LIGHT_GREEN#*她温暖地微笑着* #WHITE#那么，亲爱的，我们赶快开始吧！
这里还有一场战斗等着我们！

entries.source: Let's go!
entries.target: 开始吧！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*With the final blow, Riala falls...to suddenly burst in flames!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#You stare at the blazing inferno with understandable confusion,
#LIGHT_GREEN#until you hear her voice from behind*#WHITE#
Oh, my dear! That was quite the fight, wasn't it? I concede you the honor of victory.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*She bows politely*
Fryjia was right about you: you seem to be a champion in the works!
Oh, and please forgive her behavior. You will understand when you meet her father.
And, if you keep fighting like this, it will be really soon.
So, it's been my pleasure, @playername@. #LIGHT_GREEN#*She vanishes in a spiral of flame*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*最后一击落下，里娅拉倒地……却突然化作熊熊烈焰！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#你满心困惑地凝视着那片火海，
#LIGHT_GREEN#直到她的声音从身后传来*#WHITE#
哦，亲爱的！真是一场精彩的战斗，不是吗？胜利的荣耀归你了。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*她礼貌地鞠了一躬*
弗里嘉看得没错：你看来正成长为一名冠军！
哦，也请原谅她刚才的举止。等你见到她父亲，就会明白了。
而且，只要你继续这样战斗，那一刻很快就会到来。
很高兴与你交手，@playername@。#LIGHT_GREEN#*她在盘旋的火焰中消失*

entries.source: I am pumped up! What's next?
entries.target: 我斗志正旺！下一个是谁？

entries.source: Am I the only person with a name that can die here?
entries.target: 难道我是唯一一个有名有姓却会死在这里的人吗？

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You suddenly realize everything has turned dark.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You look around searching for your rival. And then you notice it. Standing
#LIGHT_GREEN#right before you, a massive battle armor with an equally massive battle axe.
#LIGHT_GREEN#It wasn't there just a second ago. You step back and examine him better,
#LIGHT_GREEN#realizing it's actually a human inside that hulking, worn armor. You can't see
#LIGHT_GREEN#his eyes, but you know he's piercing your soul with his stare*
f...t...ma....ll...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You hear a devilish voice, coming from everywhere at once!! But...you are
#LIGHT_GREEN#unable to understand anything! It doesn't seem like any language used in
#LIGHT_GREEN#Maj'Eyal!
#LIGHT_GREEN#And then...a piercing, demonic roar...you are overwhelmed by extreme
#LIGHT_GREEN#emotions invading your very soul!!*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你突然发现四周陷入了黑暗。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你环顾四周，寻找自己的对手。随即，你注意到了它：
#LIGHT_GREEN#一副巨型战甲就站在你面前，手持一柄同样巨大的战斧。
#LIGHT_GREEN#一瞬之前那里还空无一物。你后退一步，仔细端详，
#LIGHT_GREEN#才发现那副庞大而破旧的战甲里其实装着一个人类。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你看不见他的双眼，却知道他的目光正刺穿你的灵魂*
弗……特……玛……尔……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个魔鬼般的声音突然从四面八方同时传来！！但……
#LIGHT_GREEN#你完全听不懂！这不像
#LIGHT_GREEN#马基·埃亚尔使用的任何一种语言！
#LIGHT_GREEN#紧接着……一声刺耳的恶魔咆哮……
#LIGHT_GREEN#极端的情绪侵入灵魂，将你彻底淹没！！*

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*You valiantly stand against the darkness*
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*你英勇地挺身对抗黑暗*

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You valiantly deliver the finishing blow!*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Valfren collapses as the light returns to this world.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You close your eyes for a brief instant. Fryjia is there when you open them*
Father... #LIGHT_GREEN#*She stands silent for a few seconds*#WHITE# You win, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You have done well. Prepare for your final battle... if you win, we will be at your service.
Good luck...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After a few uncomfortable seconds, Valfren starts to move again.
#LIGHT_GREEN#He stands up and walks away with Fryjia. At the gates, Valfren turns his
#LIGHT_GREEN#head in your direction. You look at him, and then he looks above
#LIGHT_GREEN#the arena's walls. You follow his gaze... to meet the Master of the Arena*

#LIGHT_GREEN#*There it is. Your goal. Your heart beats fast, as the time has come*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Master of the Arena smiles proudly*
#RED#The final battle begins when the gate closes, just this final time!!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你英勇地使出致命一击！*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*光明重返这个世界，瓦弗伦随之倒下。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你闭眼短短一瞬；再睁开时，弗里嘉已出现在眼前*
父亲……#LIGHT_GREEN#*她沉默了几秒*#WHITE# 你赢了，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你表现得很好。准备迎接最后一战吧……如果你获胜，我们将听候你的差遣。
祝你好运……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*令人不安的几秒过后，瓦弗伦重新动了起来。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他站起身，与弗里嘉一同离去。走到大门处，瓦弗伦转头望向你。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你与他对视，随后他抬眼看向竞技场的围墙上方。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你循着他的目光……见到了竞技场主宰*

#LIGHT_GREEN#*他就在那里。你的目标。时刻终于来临，你的心跳随之加快*
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰骄傲地微笑着*
#RED#大门一关，最终决战便会开始——这是最后一次了！！

entries.source: I will defeat you, Master of the Arena!!!
entries.target: 我会打败你，竞技场主宰！！！

entries.source: I will become Master of the Arena instead of the Master of the Arena!!
entries.target: 我会取代竞技场主宰，亲自成为竞技场主宰！！

entries.source: Wealth and glory! Wealth and glory!
entries.target: 财富与荣耀！财富与荣耀！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Finally, the master of the arena comes into the gates!
#LIGHT_GREEN#The public roars with excitement as he faces you with confidence!*
I applaud you, @playerdescriptor.race@! You have fought with might and courage!
And now...the time for the final showdown!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master assumes a fighting stance. The audience cheers!*
Like you, I started from nowhere. I won't underestimate someone with such potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master smirks, you assume your fighting stance as well, and the
#LIGHT_GREEN#audience cheers you as well, making the excitement grow inside you*
Can you hear it, the public cheering? That's what this is about.
Pursue glory with all your might, @playerdescriptor.race@!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master steps forward into the sand*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*终于，竞技场主宰穿过大门，步入场中！
#LIGHT_GREEN#他自信地与你对峙，观众兴奋地咆哮起来！*
值得称赞，@playerdescriptor.race@！你凭力量与勇气一路奋战至此！
现在……最终对决的时刻到了！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰摆出战斗架势。观众放声欢呼！*
和你一样，我也曾从一无所有起步。我不会低估像你这样潜力非凡的人。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰得意一笑；你也摆出战斗架势，
#LIGHT_GREEN#观众同样为你欢呼，令你心中的激动愈发高涨*
听见了吗？观众正在欢呼。这才是竞技场的意义。
用尽全力追逐荣耀吧，@playerdescriptor.race@！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*竞技场主宰向前踏入沙场*

entries.source: Wealth and glory!!!
entries.target: 财富与荣耀！！！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*After a glorious battle, the Master falls!*
Hah...haha. You did it, @playerdescriptor.race@...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The master of the arena, defeated, stands up with a wide smile.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Feeling the master's approval, you pick up its weapon, now lying
#LIGHT_GREEN#in the blood-stained sand.*
Everyone! We got a champion today!!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The audience rages and shouts your name repeatedly*
Congratulations, @playerdescriptor.race@. You are the Master now.
Now you shall take your rightful place as the champion.
Just remember...like me, you shall fall one day...
But meanwhile, this is your place! Welcome to paradise, @playerdescriptor.race@!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You see several sponsors and military recruiters approach the
#LIGHT_GREEN#now defeated master, offering deals and good positions in the army.
#LIGHT_GREEN#You smile, victorious, knowing your life will be glorious from now on.
#LIGHT_GREEN#Because even if you are defeated in the future...
#LIGHT_GREEN#You can always sell your image and live large.

#YELLOW#CONGRATULATIONS!
#YELLOW#You are the new master of the arena! You are great and epic!
#YELLOW#You shall remain as the new master until someone challenges you!
#YELLOW#Next time you play, you shall battle this new champion instead!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一场辉煌的战斗过后，竞技场主宰倒下了！*
哈……哈哈。你做到了，@playerdescriptor.race@……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*战败的竞技场主宰站起身，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。
#LIGHT_GREEN#感受到他的认可，你拾起了他的武器——
#LIGHT_GREEN#它正落在染血的沙地上。*
各位！我们今天迎来了一位冠军！！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*观众沸腾起来，一遍遍高喊你的名字*
恭喜你，@playerdescriptor.race@。如今你才是竞技场主宰。
现在，你将登上冠军应得的位置。
只要记住……和我一样，你终有一天也会倒下……
但在那之前，这里属于你！欢迎来到天堂，@playerdescriptor.race@！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你看到几名赞助人和军方招募者走向落败的前任主宰，
#LIGHT_GREEN#向他提出合作条件，并许诺军中的优厚职位。
#LIGHT_GREEN#你以胜利者的姿态微笑着，知道自己此后的人生必将辉煌。
#LIGHT_GREEN#因为即使你将来落败……
#LIGHT_GREEN#也总能靠自己的名气赚得盆满钵满。

#YELLOW#恭喜！
#YELLOW#你是新的竞技场主宰！伟大而传奇！
#YELLOW#在有人前来挑战之前，你将一直担任新的竞技场主宰！
#YELLOW#下次游玩时，你将与这位新冠军交战！

entries.source: WEALTH!! AND!! GLORYYYYY!!
I won't need to save chicks from cults anymore!
entries.target: 我再也不用从邪教那里救姑娘们了！

entries.source: I hereby stand victorious, awaiting future challenges!
entries.target: 我已获胜，在此静候未来的挑战！

entries.target: 我没空闲聊！去跟老大说！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#You and the Lord discuss your new relationship at some length, including the merits of assassination by proxy and some additional trapping techniques.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#你与刺客领主详谈了你们的新关系，包括借刀杀人的益处以及一些额外的陷阱技巧。

entries.source: As you depart the assassin lord says: 'And do not forget, I own you now.'
entries.target: 当你离开时，刺客领主说道：“别忘了，你现在归我所有了。”

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a menacing man clothed in black.*#WHITE#
Ahh, the intruder at last... And what shall we do with you? Why did you kill my men?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个身穿黑衣的凶恶男人。*#WHITE#
啊，入侵者终于现身了……我们该怎么处置你呢？你为什么杀我的人？

entries.source: I heard some cries, and your men... they were in my way. What's going on here?
entries.target: 我听到了呼喊声，而你的人……挡了我的路。这里发生了什么事？

entries.source: I thought there might be some treasure to be had around here.
entries.target: 我以为能在这里捞到些财宝。

entries.source: Sorry, I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我要走了！

entries.source: Oh, you are not going anywhere, I'm afraid! KILL!
entries.target: 哦，恐怕你哪儿也去不了！给我杀！

entries.source: [attack]
entries.target: [攻击]

entries.source: Wait! Maybe we could work out some kind of arrangement; you seem to be a practical man.
entries.target: 等等！也许我们能达成某种协议；你看上去是个讲求实际的人。

entries.source: Oh, so this is the part where I tell you my plan before you attack me? GET THIS INTRUDER!
entries.target: 哦，所以现在该轮到我在你动手前透露计划了？拿下这个入侵者！

entries.source: I am afraid this is not your lucky day then. The merchant is ours... and so are you! GET THIS INTRUDER!!
entries.target: 恐怕今天不是你的幸运日。那个商人是我们的了……你也是！拿下这个入侵者！！

entries.source:
Well, I need somebody to replace the men you killed. You look sturdy; maybe you could work for me.
You will have to do some dirty work for me, though, and you will be bound to me.  Nevertheless, you may make quite a profit from this venture, if you are as good as you seem to be.
And do not think of crossing me.  That would be... unwise.
entries.target:
好吧，我正需要有人来顶替被你杀掉的那些手下。你看上去挺结实；也许你能替我干活。
不过，你得替我干些脏活，而且你将受制于我。话说回来，只要你的本事真有看上去那么过硬，你也能在这桩买卖中捞到不少好处。
另外，可别动跟我作对的心思。那会……非常不明智。

entries.source: Well, I suppose it is better than dying.
entries.target: 好吧，我想总比送命强。

entries.source: Money? I'm in!
entries.target: 有钱赚？算我一个！

entries.source: Just let me and the merchant get out of here and you may live!
entries.target: 只要放我和商人离开这里，我就饶你不死！

entries.source: Uhh, okay. Sure. Mind showing me?
entries.target: 呃，好吧。行啊。能给我看看吗？

entries.source:
<<<You feel a gentle warmth in your mind. Something speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#HELLO FRIEND. I AM A STAR FROM FAR AWAY. I HAVE HEARD YOU PRAISING YOUR SUN. WHY NOT PRAISE ME INSTEAD? I AM A MUCH BETTER SUN THAN THAT DULL, LIFELESS GAS ORB IN YOUR VICINITY. PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO DEMONSTRATE MY GOOD INTENTIONS.
entries.target:
<<<你在脑海中感受到一阵温和的暖意。有什么在你的脑海中直接对你说话！>>>
#YELLOW#你好，朋友。我是一颗来自远方的恒星。我听到了你对太阳的赞美。为什么不转而赞美我呢？比起你附近那颗枯燥乏味、毫无生气的气态球体，我是一颗好得多的太阳。请允许我向你展示我的善意。

entries.source: I don't take unsolicited messages from... stars.
entries.target: 我不接受……恒星擅自发来的消息。

entries.source: #YELLOW#YOU ONLY HAD TO ASK, MY FRIEND.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你只需开口，我的朋友。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#[The area around you erupts in flames, burning your foes]
entries.target: #CRIMSON#[你周围腾起烈焰，焚烧你的敌人]

entries.source: If you say so.
entries.target: 既然你这么说。

entries.source: Look, I appreciate the offer, but I don't know you.
entries.target: 听着，我感谢你的好意，但我根本不认识你。

entries.source: #YELLOW#DON'T BE LIKE THAT. I KNOW YOU ARE ON A NOBLE QUEST.
entries.target: #YELLOW#别这样。我知道你身负一项崇高的使命。

entries.source: I'm busy at the moment, so maybe call back another time?
entries.target: 我现在正忙，能改天再联系吗？

entries.source: #YELLOW#I AM YOUR FRIEND. NOW YOU KNOW ME. LET US BEGIN A LONG AND FRUITFUL FRIENDSHIP.
entries.target: #YELLOW#我是你的朋友。现在你认识我了。让我们建立长久而有益的友谊吧。

entries.source: #YELLOW#BUSY, YOU SAY? I CAN FIX THAT, LIKE ANY GOOD FRIEND WOULD.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你说你在忙？我可以帮你搞定，好朋友都会这么做。

entries.source: #YELLOW#YOU DON'T BELIEVE ME? THEN PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO SHOW YOU A MERE FRACTION OF MY POWER.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你不相信我？那么，请允许我向你展示我的一小部分力量。
